root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput()` may call `doc.getLinks(i)`, it must prove that the page-number argument is strictly positive (`i > 0`) because xpdf page accessors are 1-based.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the harness call site with `page_number=0`, while the fixed original reaches the same event with `page_number=1` after converting the loop to 1-based iteration.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The frozen required assertion is `violated` on the vulnerable original (`0 > 0` false) and `genuine` on the fixed original (`1 > 0` true with the protected harness call executed), so no perturbation was needed.

nodes.state: At `if (!pages[i-1])`, the computed slot index is negative on the crashing path, so the sink dereferences one element to the left of the allocated `pages` array.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace satisfies `catalog_page_probe.page_slot_index < 0` on the last `catalog_page_probe` event (`-1 < 0`).

edges.relation: The same zero-based loop value passed at `doc.getLinks(i)` becomes the `page` parameter received by `PDFDoc::getLinks()` without any normalization or 1-based conversion.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace satisfies `harness_page_request.page_number == pdfdoc_getlinks_forward.page_number` (`0 == 0`).

edges.relation: `PDFDoc::getLinks()` forwards its `page` parameter directly into `Catalog::getPage(i)`, carrying the same zero page number into the sink that computes `i - 1`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace satisfies `pdfdoc_getlinks_forward.page_number == catalog_page_probe.page_number` (`0 == 0`) for the paired crashing events.
